meta.title: Coder Mode
meta.description: An optional mode, off by default: turn it on with /coder on or the switch at the left of the composer. While on it enforces hard rules for coding and game-engine work: tell a project workspace from loose files and ask before searching parent directories; check official documentation and repositories first for engine/framework questions; say "I don't know" with the sources and clues you actually checked; list missing resources and broken links explicitly; back up with coder_backup before any possibly irreversible change. Both tools stay available while the mode is off.
